an3.77:2.4: This discourse differs from the previous only inasmuch as it says “intention” (_cetanā_) and “aim” (_patthanā_) rather than “consciousness” ([an3.76:2.4]()). In the process of rebirth, all five aggregates are involved ([sn22.79:1.2]()). Consciousness conveys information, while intention drives the direction.
